name: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
access: Google Workspace (Docs Live, Gmail Live, Keep Live)
Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (listed in the model card; Google's Cloud blog of 2026-09-25 says the model remains in private preview)

output: text (a transcript of the audio; the response modality must be audio)
video (Live Avatar; the model card lists it for this model)

voice.input_audio: Same as gemini-3.8-live: raw 16-bit PCM, little-endian, mono, 16 kHz native, resampled if the MIME type states the rate; images and video as JPEG frames, at most 1 frame a second [gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-overview]
voice.output_audio: Same as gemini-3.8-live: raw 16-bit PCM, little-endian, 24 kHz, with a SynthID watermark [gemini-live-capabilities, google-3-8-live-blog]
voice.voices: Same prebuilt voices as gemini-3.8-live; no count given for the Live API [gemini-live-capabilities]
languages: Same as gemini-3.8-live. Google's pages give 97, 99, 70 and 24 languages and do not say which applies to this model [google-3-8-live-blog, gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-overview, gemini-cloud-live-overview]
voice.turn_detection: Server-side voice activity detection is on by default (realtimeInputConfig.automaticActivityDetection). Settings: start_of_speech_sensitivity, end_of_speech_sensitivity, prefix_padding_ms and silence_duration_ms. The server default for silence is about 800 ms, and Google advises 500 to 800 ms [gemini-live-capabilities]. Automatic detection can be turned off (disabled: true). The client then sends activityStart and activityEnd, and Google advises a client silence threshold of at least 500 ms. A hybrid mode keeps server detection for the start of speech and lets a client detector send audio_stream_end for a fast end of turn [gemini-live-capabilities]. The client sends audioStreamEnd when the microphone pauses for more than one second [gemini-live-capabilities]. Because reasoning runs in the background, turnComplete: true does not mean the session is idle. Google says to read interaction_status: IN_PROGRESS while it works and IDLE when all processing is done [gemini-spec-3-8-live-et, gemini-live-thinking].
voice.interruption: Barge-in is supported. When detection hears the user during output, the server cancels the generation, discards pending function calls and sends interrupted: true. The client must drop its queued playback audio at once [gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-best-practices]. Google's launch post says the model speaks an early verbal cue, such as a short line that it is checking, and narrates progress while background work runs [google-3-8-live-blog].
voice.latency: 1.35 seconds average time to first audio at high thinking on Artificial Analysis's Big Bench Audio set [aa-speech-to-speech]. Google publishes no figure.
voice.session_limit: Without context window compression an audio-only session ends after 15 minutes and an audio-plus-video session after 2 minutes. With compression and session resumption a session can run without a time limit. One connection lasts about 10 minutes, and the server sends GoAway before it closes the connection. Resumption handles stay valid for 2 hours after the session ends. The session context window is 128k tokens [gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-session]. On Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform the limit is 1,000 concurrent sessions per project on pay-as-you-go, and GoAway comes 60 seconds before the end [gemini-cloud-live-session].

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Gemini API pricing page, paid plan, standard rate. Input: text $0.75, audio $3.00 (about $0.005 a minute), image or video $1.00 (about $0.002 a minute). Output: text $4.50, audio $12.00 (about $0.018 a minute), and the output price includes thinking tokens. The input and output fields of this card hold the audio rates. Audio counts 25 tokens a second [gemini-live-best-practices]. Each turn bills the whole session context again, so the cost of a turn grows with session length [gemini-live-best-practices]. Turning on audio transcription adds text output tokens at the text rate. Search grounding: 5,000 free requests a month shared across Gemini 3.x models, then $14 per 1,000 requests. The free plan costs nothing and Google may use its data to improve products; the paid plan is not used for that. One table covers gemini-3.8-live, gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking and gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview [gemini-pricing]. No caching, no batch.

status: generally available on the Gemini API since 2026-09-15 per the changelog; Google Cloud's blog of 2026-09-25 says the model remains in private preview on Gemini Enterprise, and the Enterprise Agent Platform's Live API overview lists only gemini-3.8-live and an older 2.5 id. The Live API guide pages still carry a preview banner
context_window: the model page says 131,072 input tokens and the model card says 128K; 131,072 kept
modalities: the Live Avatar video output is named for this model in the model card, and in the Cloud blog only for gemini-3.8-live; the Cloud blog says Extended Thinking stays in private preview

voice.latency: Google publishes no latency figure; the figure recorded is a measurer's

benchmarks: Google's evaluation file shows its results as chart images. Its Sierra tau3-Banking chart shows 35.1 for this model at high thinking, the same as the launch post. Its EVA-Bench chart is a scatter plot with no data labels. Artificial Analysis ran the model under the id gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking with thinking high
